policy.general_use: The finished item can be used without the crafting profession.
policy.hard_restricted: The finished item record requires a profession skill and rank to use.
policy.profession_audience: The item has no direct skill gate, but its only practical purpose is as a profession tool, profession reagent, or container for a restricted item.
policy.exclude: Remove BoP, nontradeable, self-only, conjured, temporary, or invalid outputs from AH listings.
policy.input_exception: Raw materials, recipes, and explicitly labeled components remain in their existing input sections because RequiredSkill can describe milling, prospecting, learning, or crafting behavior rather than exclusive ownership.
